title: EyeVQA: Benchmarking Ophthalmic Vision-Language Models from Recognition to Spatial Grounding
abstract: arXiv:2609.32352v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown increasing potential for medical image understanding, yet their capabilities in ophthalmic imaging remain insufficiently characterized. Existing ophthalmic datasets are typically designed for individual diseases or specialized tasks, making it difficult to systematically evaluate whether VLMs can move beyond disease recognition toward comparative reasoning and fine-grained spatial grounding. We introduce EyeVQA, a unified visual question answering benchmark for comprehensive evaluation of ophthalmic VLMs. EyeVQA is constructed from 21 available ophthalmic datasets and contains 20,000 question-answer pairs spanning six disease groups and seven question types: Single-Choice, Multi-Select, Variable-Select, True-False, Ranking, Point Location, and Bounding Box. translated_title: EyeVQA：从疾病识别到空间定位的眼科视觉语言模型基准测试
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）在医学图像理解方面展现出越来越大的潜力，但其在眼科影像领域的能力仍未得到充分刻画。现有的眼科数据集通常针对单一疾病或专门任务设计，难以系统性地评估视觉语言模型能否超越疾病识别，进而实现比较推理和细粒度空间定位。我们提出了EyeVQA，一个用于全面评估眼科视觉语言模型的统一视觉问答基准。EyeVQA由21个可用的眼科数据集构建而成，包含20,000个问答对，涵盖六大疾病类别和七种题型：单选题、多选题、可变选择题、判断题、排序题、点定位题和边界框题。标准答案确定性地来源于原始数据所提供的诊断、严重程度分级、临床发现、分割掩码等信息（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了EyeVQA，一个由21个眼科数据集构建、包含2万个问答对的统一视觉问答基准，涵盖六大疾病类别和七种题型，首次系统性地评估眼科视觉语言模型从疾病识别到比较推理和细粒度空间定位的综合能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces EyeVQA, a unified visual question answering benchmark built from 21 ophthalmic datasets containing 20,000 question-answer pairs across six disease groups and seven question types, enabling the first systematic evaluation of ophthalmic VLMs from disease recognition to comparative reasoning and fine-grained spatial grounding.
